WELLS FARGO 
Intern Analyst - Summer Internship 
 
 
 
Vedant Kale 
Computer Engineering 
Batch 2026 
Location : Hyderabad/Bangalore 
Stipend : INR 90,000

Round 1 : Online Assessment - 22nd April, 2025 
Platform : SHL (Video and Screen proctored) 
Duration : Around 2 hours 
The online assessment consisted of: 
1.​ GenAI Aptitude 
2.​ Verbal Aptitude 
a.​ Fill in the blanks with appropriate words 
b.​ Basic grammar questions 
c.​ Questions based on the given passage 
3.​ Business Aptitude 
a.​ Questions on graph analysis 
4.​ Coding Section - 2 coding questions 
5.​ Advanced Coding Section - 1 coding question 
 
I don’t remember the exact coding questions, but one was based on Maps and 
another on Binary Exponentiation. Both questions were easy, and I was able to 
solve them. 
In the advanced coding section, the question was a Cryptarithmetic problem, like: 
Input: SEND + MORE​
Output: MONEY 
I wasn’t able to come up with a full solution during the test, so I hardcoded the 
values. That approach passed 2 out of 3 test cases. 
 
 
2

Results: 
25 people were shortlisted for interviews, and I was one of them. We received the 
results on 29 April, 2025, in the afternoon.  
Start preparing for the interviews as soon as you are done with the OA. Don’t wait 
for the results as they are always announced only the day before interviews.
 
3

Round 2 : Technical Interview- 30th April, 2025 
Platform : Microsoft Teams 
Duration : Around 30 minutes 
The interview started with a short introduction about myself. Then the interviewer 
began with CS fundamentals. 
In DSA, he asked me to give real-world examples for different data structures like 
Queue, Stack, Linked List, Graph, and Dynamic Programming.​
 After that, he asked me about the advantages and disadvantages of singly and 
doubly linked lists. 
Next, we moved to OOPs, where he asked me to explain the 4 pillars of OOP with 
examples. He also asked the difference between a shallow copy and a deep copy. 
Then we moved to DBMS. He asked about the ACID properties and the difference 
between MySQL and MongoDB. He also asked why I used MongoDB over SQL in 
one of my projects. 
After that, he asked a few coding questions. I don’t remember all of them exactly, 
but here’s what I recall: 
●​ One question was to create a file in C++, read data from it, and count the 
number of words, showing knowledge of C++ file handling in detail. 
●​ Then, I had to count the frequency of each word and store it in another file. 
●​ Another question was to reverse an array and then a linked list. 
In the end, he asked if I had any questions for him. 
 
 
4

Results: 
12 people were shortlisted for the third round, and I was one of them. We received 
the results on 6 May, 2025. 
 
 
 
 
5

Round 3 : Technical Interview- 9th May, 2025 
Platform : Microsoft Teams 
Duration : Around 30 minutes 
The second interview was conducted by a senior professional from Wells Fargo and 
mainly focused on my projects and behavioral skills. 
He started by asking me to introduce myself, and then asked me to explain all the 
projects mentioned in my resume.​
He appreciated my work and said that my projects were really impressive. 
After that, he asked me a few technical questions: 
1.​ Difference between JavaScript and TypeScript 
2.​ Difference between React.js and Next.js 
3.​ Difference between MongoDB and MySQL 
Then he asked a situational question:​
"If you completed a project 3 days before the deadline and later realized you                
misunderstood the requirements, how would you respond?"​
He also asked, "How will you make sure such things don’t happen again?" 
We then discussed code quality. He asked how I ensure clean code, and followed 
up with:​
"How do you measure code coverage?"​
I talked about using Mocha, Chai, and Jest for testing, and at that time my Software 
Engineering course helped me understand these concepts better. 
At the end, I asked him about the technologies used in his team for maintaining 
code quality and measuring coverage. 
 
6

He also asked what I’m currently working on. I said I’m focusing on CP and DSA.​
He advised me to keep doing development alongside DSA, mentioning that DSA 
helps in online assessments, but development is equally important. 
Lastly, I asked him about his role in the company, he said he mainly works with 
AngularJs and he ended by appreciating my attitude and skills. 
 
Results: 
9 candidates were shortlisted and proceeded to the next round. We received the 
results on 13th May 2025. 
 
 
7

Round 4 : HR Interview- 14th May, 2025 
Platform : Microsoft Teams 
Duration : Around 20 minutes 
The final round was an HR interview, and it was a casual discussion-based round. 
He began by asking me to introduce myself and then asked me to explain the 
projects where I’ve used Generative AI. 
After that, he asked about my current CGPA and the percentage I scored in my 
diploma. He then asked, Why do you want to join Wells Fargo and What motivates 
you? 
Next, he asked how I felt about the previous two technical rounds, and whether I 
would be willing to relocate if selected for the internship. 
At the end, I asked him a question about how the Tareef acquisition/merger 
affected the company, and what changes happened afterward. 
 
Results: 
On 19th May 2025, 5 people were selected for the internship, and I’m thankful to be 
one of them. The whole process happened during our semester exams, so it really 
tested our patience and focus. But in the end, everything went well and it was a 
great experience.  
Lastly, I’ve realised that sometimes, even with your best efforts, things might not go 
as planned  and that’s okay. Often it’s just about timing and staying open to what 
comes next. What truly matters is to keep moving forward, stay consistent, and 
believe in your journey.  
 
8

Preparation Tips 
1. Technical aspects you have to prepare, no doubt in that. But make sure you 
prepare on your communication skills and there’s only one way to do it and it's 
practice. Talk to people, strangers, your teachers, higher authorities, take any 
opportunity of public speaking. 
2. Practice important DSA topics well in advance. While solving DSA questions, 
have a time bound and speak up your approach like you are talking to an 
interviewer 
3. Refer 30-40 important questions list on GFG/Interview Bit for OS, DBMS, OOPS. 
ChatGPT can be very helpful for solving doubts and explaining key concepts. 
4. During interview try to speak whatever you think, long silence can be boring for 
the interviewer. 
5. Know your resume, read each and every word of it. 
6. Body language is important, so have an upright, confident posture during the 
Interview. 
 
ALL THE BEST!!!
